hero.title: Your evcc data for the energy transition
hero.subtitle: Help us understand how electric vehicles are actually charged in everyday life. Anonymously, quickly, scientifically.

why.title: Why do we need your data?
why.item1: Models are often based on assumptions - we want to see real-world usage.
why.item2: Charging times, charging rates, charging habits, and the percentage of solar power - these factors are crucial for research.
why.item3: Only the community can provide this kind of data.

quoteOne.text: For me, evcc Crowdscience is the logical next step: open-source software meets open-data research. Real usage patterns yield practical insights, which we can then use to develop new features and optimizations for evcc.
quoteOne.author: Michael Geers

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.anonymousAnswer: Yes. We do not collect any personal data and store all data only under a pseudonym.
faq.durationAnswer: Setup takes 2-3 minutes. After that, you can donate for as long as you like. A year or longer would be great for us - but it's up to you!
faq.pseudonymizationAnswer: The data is pseudonymized using a token that only you know. Only you can link the token to your evcc instance. This provides optimal protection for your privacy.
faq.storedDataAnswer: Only data necessary for technical purposes is stored: charging power, PV generation, battery status, grid consumption/feed-in. No personal information, no IP addresses, no location data.

background.title: Background
background.p1: Real charging profiles of electric vehicles are of great importance to research and the energy sector. Many models are based on assumptions, but actual charging behavior often differs significantly from theoretical scenarios. This is also demonstrated by our previous studies, such as those on the variability of solar charging and the factors influencing the share of PV power.
background.p2: To bridge this gap, we are conducting a crowdscience project that actively involves users of wallboxes and EV solutions. Participation is anonymous, voluntary, and takes only a few minutes.

goal.title: Goal of the project
goal.item1: when and for how long charging actually takes place
goal.item2: what the actual charging power is
goal.item3: how surplus PV charging behaves in everyday life
goal.item4: what patterns, deviations, and peculiarities arise
goal.item5: and how much variation there is between households
goal.outro: This data enables scientific analyses, such as those already conducted in our study on real solar charging profiles. It helps us visualize actual usage - no more and no less.

participation.textSuffix: There, users can anonymously submit their evcc data. No personal data is collected; all information is used exclusively for research purposes.

benefits.title: Benefits for Participants
benefits.item1: support for independent research at HTW Berlin
benefits.item2: contribution to an open dataset that reveals real charging behavior
benefits.item4: strengthening the open science community in the field of energy and mobility

motivation.title: Why do we need your data?
motivation.p1: In our energy research on decentralized energy systems, we rely on time-series data. This data serves as input for simulations and helps us better understand the systems and interactions between solar panels, batteries, electric vehicles, and/or heat pumps.
motivation.p2: Only in this way can we develop solutions and anticipate the technical challenges we need to address for the energy transition. Our work is not driven by any company or profit motive, but by the conviction that we want to support the energy transition through our research.
motivation.p3: The problem: There is currently no comparable open dataset containing real data from decentralized energy systems.

plan.title: Here's the plan
plan.p1: As evcc users, you handle this data - which is crucial to us - on a daily basis. We'd like to use your data contributions to advance our research and that of others.
plan.p2: For this purpose, we intend to record anonymized data from your evcc and make it available as an open dataset. This would be a unique dataset that, depending on the number of participants, could make a significant contribution to research on decentralized energy systems.
plan.p3: It is important to us that, in addition to ensuring the desired level of detail in the dataset, strict anonymization ensures that no compromises are made regarding data protection!

addedValue.title: What is the added value?
addedValue.researchText: A unique open dataset containing real data from decentralized energy systems, enabling reproducible analyses and supporting well-founded decisions that go beyond marketing.
addedValue.communityText: The ability to store time series data long-term with visualizations, even without your own InfluxDB. Another key benefit is planned features, such as the ability to compare data with other instances - currently only possible among known users.

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.p1: We have opted for token-based registration and MQTT data sharing. The data is stored in InfluxDB and can be viewed on the website by entering your token.
procedure.p2: Any data from evcc that might contain personal information is not stored. Anyone who does not know which token corresponds to you cannot link the data to you (pseudonymization known only to you).
procedure.p3: If you no longer wish to participate, you can simply stop sharing data by removing our MQTT broker from evcc. Members of the research group have the option to view and compare all instances.

privacy.title: Privacy & Anonymization
privacy.intro: Your anonymity is our top priority:
privacy.item1: no personal information from evcc is stored
privacy.item2: pseudonymization via tokens - without knowledge of the token, no association is possible
privacy.item3: data sharing can be disabled in evcc at any time
privacy.item4: no IP addresses or location data

general.title: 1. General Information
general.text: We take the protection of your data seriously. Your data is processed exclusively in accordance with the legal provisions of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other relevant data protection laws.

controller.title: 2. Responsible Authority
controller.intro: The entity responsible for data processing in connection with this project is:

processed.title: 3. Processed Data
processed.p1: Within the context of the project, only anonymized or pseudonymized data is processed, which users voluntarily provide via the data donation feature. Pseudonymized data contains an ID that is used in an MQTT topic to identify the data. This ID ensures that while the data is associated with a specific instance, it is not possible to identify individual persons. No personal data is collected or stored. In particular, we do not store IP addresses or other direct identifiers.
processed.p2: Anonymized data cannot be traced back to individual persons and is used exclusively for scientific research.
processed.item1: Technical data generated by a wallbox or the evcc system (e.g., charging times, energy consumption, charging power).
processed.item2: Metadata that contributes to analysis (e.g., timestamps, evcc version used).
processed.userGeneratedText: Some data in the evcc system can be entered by users themselves and may contain personal information. Whenever possible, this data is discarded immediately upon receipt. Nevertheless, we would like to remind you not to enter any personal data in these fields that could, for example, reveal your address. Such information is processed anonymously, but we recommend that you do not use any sensitive or identifying information to protect your privacy.
processed.importantText: No personal data is collected or stored.
processed.p3: All data is anonymized or pseudonymized before processing, so that it is impossible to identify you personally.

purpose.title: 4. Purposes of Data Processing
purpose.intro: The anonymized data will be used exclusively for scientific purposes, in particular for:
purpose.item1: Research in the fields of sustainable mobility, solar energy use, and energy efficiency.
purpose.item2: Development and improvement of technologies for controlling and optimizing charging processes.

legalBasis.title: 5. Legal basis for data processing
legalBasis.text: Data processing is based on Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR (consent).

retention.title: 6. Retention period
retention.text: The data will be stored for the duration of the project. The goal is to publish the collected data in a repository under a CC-BY-4.0 license, provided the community agrees.

sharing.title: 7. Sharing of Data
sharing.text: The data will not be shared with third parties. The goal is to publish the collected data in a repository under a CC-BY-4.0 license, provided the community agrees. The data will not be used for commercial purposes.

transparency.title: 8. Transparency
transparency.text: We provide all users with a dashboard to ensure transparency regarding the collected data. On this dashboard, individuals can view the data they have donated and which has been anonymized at any time.

rights.title: 9. Your Rights
rights.intro: Since we do not collect personal data, the standard data protection rights to access, erasure, and withdrawal apply only to a limited extent:
rights.item1Text: You can discontinue data donation at any time by deactivating the corresponding function in evcc.
rights.item2Text: You can view information about the data donated by your instance via the dashboard at any time.
rights.item3Text: Once donated, non-personal data cannot be withdrawn; however, you are free to stop donating data at any time.
rights.outro: If you have any questions, you can reach us using the contact information provided above.

changes.title: 10. Changes to the Privacy Policy
changes.text: We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy as necessary to comply with current legal requirements or to reflect changes in the project workflow.

viewData.title: View your own data
viewData.instruction: You can view your data by entering your instance ID below.
viewData.ctaBefore: Don't have an ID yet? You can

step1.title: Get an ID
step1.paragraph1: To donate data, you will receive an ID that is assigned to your evcc instance.
step1.paragraph2: This ID is used in your MQTT topic to identify the data coming from your instance.
step1.paragraph3: You can save the ID to access your analyzed data later.
step1.paragraph4: Your data will be used exclusively in anonymized form and for scientific purposes.
step1.consentAfter: and agree to the anonymized processing of my data.

step2.title: Add MQTT integration to evcc
step2.question: Have you already set up another broker in evcc?

noBroker.step2: Go to the Configuration settings and enable the experimental UI features (Experimental: on) in the General section.
noBroker.step3: In the Integration section, add our MQTT integration. You only need to set the topic (which contains your ID) and the broker; leave everything else blank.

withBroker.notice: In order for us to receive your data, you need to set up a bridge that forwards the evcc data.
withBroker.question: Are you using evcc on Linux or in Home Assistant (Mosquitto add-on)?
withBroker.bridgeConfig:
connection evcc-crowdscience
address mqtt-native.evcc-crowdscience.de:8883

# Optional local authentication (if required)
# local_username <local-username>
# CA certificate path, enables TLS
# bridge_capath /etc/ssl/certs

# Forward all local evcc topics to the remote prefix
topic # out 1 evcc/ evcc/{{instanceId}}/

keepalive_interval 60
restart_timeout 10 30
start_type automatic
cleansession true
withBroker.topicLine: If you are not using the default topic evcc/, line 10 must be modified:
withBroker.homeConfig: Under Settings → Apps (Add-ons) → Mosquitto broker → Configuration
withBroker.homeCustomizeAfter: active to true and specify mosquitto as the folder
withBroker.privatePrefix: Your data is not transmitted publicly.
withBroker.privateSuffix: The connection is encrypted, and our MQTT server is configured to allow data points to be sent to us without authentication. Only authorized clients can read this data.

step3.title: Restart evcc & check the connection
step3.status: Your data should arrive shortly! If you don't see any data within a minute, go back and check that your MQTT integration is set up correctly.

step4.title: View data
step4.received: Data associated with your instance ID has been received!
step4.summary: You can now view your data summary. Save the link or your instance ID to view the analysis results later.
